'''Sonou's Apparel''' was a [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] shop which was located on a hangar deck level of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The shop was run by a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Sonou]] and had a staff consisting of other Twi'leks as well as [[Droid/Legends|droids]], all of whom Sonou ordered around relentlessly. Sonou's Apparel stocked a complete range of clothes, designed to be [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-ready and available in designs to fit a number of common [[Species/Legends|species]]. The clothes, which included [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuits]], [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuits]], formal wear and environment specific garments, was all sold at about two thirds of the common market value due to the fact it was a lower quality than standard clothing. Most apparel bought at the store would last half the amount of time that clothing from elsewhere would, a fact Sonou freely told those who asked. The Twi'lek, who made a good living from the store, was always civil to customers despite how she behaved toward her staff.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sonou's Apparel first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. It was included as a location that players could potentially visit whilst searching for information on the Wheel.
